cats.name: Skye
cats.bio: Meet Skye! Meet Skye, a beautiful two-month-old tabby and white kitten with an adorable little face and bright, curious eyes! This sweet young lady has a lifetime of adventures ahead of her, from chasing toys and exploring new surroundings to discovering the perfect spot for an afternoon snooze. With plenty of love, playtime, and gentle socialization, Skye will have the opportunity to blossom into a wonderful companion. Give this little girl a place to call home, and the sky's the limit! I may be able to live with other dogs and/or cats. I may be able to live with children. Email the filled-out adoption form to: adoption@cochranehumane.ca ‍

cats.name: Oreo
cats.bio: Meet Oreo! Meet Oreo, an adorable two-month-old calico with beautiful markings and the sweetest little face! This little lady is just beginning her adventures in life and has a whole world of toys, cozy nap spots, and new experiences waiting to be discovered. With plenty of playtime, gentle socialization, and love, Oreo will have the opportunity to grow into a confident and happy companion. Could this colourful little cutie be the missing ingredient in your family? I may be able to live with other dogs and/or cats. I may be able to live with children. Email the filled-out adoption form to: adoption@cochranehumane.ca ‍

cats.name: Snowflake
cats.bio: *I am in a foster home. Meet Snowflake: The Little Snowflake Who Needs Time to Melt Female | Black shorthair | Professional heart-melter Who says snowflakes have to be white? This little Snowflake is dressed entirely in black, with the softest, most luxurious short fur and enormous round golden-yellow eyes that could melt even the iciest heart. And her personality? Somehow even softer than her fur. Snowflake is the sweetest, gentlest little soul. When a new kitten joined her foster family, she welcomed him and his initial out-of-fear aggression with remarkable patience and kindness, even though she's still learning to be brave around humans herself. Not a hiss, not a fuss, just quiet acceptance and the sort of generosity that makes you wish more people were like cats. Snowflake is a shy little lady. Her first instinct when approached is often to run away, but don't mistake her caution for a lack of affection. She's simply a tender heart who needs time to learn that humans can be trusted. Watching her foster sister happily purr away in someone's arms has been her best lesson in human appreciation. Apparently, purring is contagious! And if you happen to arrive bearing a tube treat? Well, negotiations may proceed considerably faster. Snowflake isn't the kitten who will throw herself into your arms on day one. She's the kitten who will make you earn her trust, one gentle moment at a time. And when she finally chooses you, you'll know you've been given something truly special. Looking for someone with a patient heart, a gentle touch, and a generous supply of tube treats. Her love may take time to blossom, but the sweetest things are always worth waiting for. Littermates: Sugar Pie, Sleighbell

cats.name: Sugar Pie
cats.bio: *I am in a foster home. Meet Sugar Pie: Sweet as Sugar, Twice as Spicy! Female | Grey-and-white tabby | Chief Executive of Cuteness Some kittens need time to come out of their shells. Sugar Pie would like to know what shell you're talking about and whether there are treats inside. This ridiculously adorable grey-and-white tabby girl is exactly as sweet as her name suggests, but don't let all that sugar fool you. She's got confidence to spare, personality for days, and absolutely no intention of hiding her fabulous self from the world. Sugar Pie approaches life with the cheerful certainty that everything is wonderful, everyone is a potential friend, and every interesting situation deserves her immediate involvement. She's cute, she knows it, and frankly, she's not wrong. Her greatest weakness? Temptations. The crunchy little treats, that is, although we suspect she's responsible for quite a few temptations herself. Open a bag and you've got her undivided attention. Whether that attention lasts after the treats are gone is between you and Sugarpie. She's the perfect little combination of sweetness, confidence, and playful charm. No complicated introductions, no elaborate courtship. Sugarpie is ready to make herself right at home and bring a generous helping of joy to your everyday life. Warning: May cause excessive smiling, spontaneous baby talk, and an inexplicable increase in your Temptations budget. Sugar Pie is ready to sweeten your life. Are you ready for a little extra sugar? Littermates: Snowflake, Sleighbell

cats.name: Shorty
cats.bio: Meet Shorty! Shorty is an adorable 3-month-old girl with a gentle heart who's slowly discovering that humans can be pretty wonderful! This sweet little kitten is still shy, but thanks to the patience and kindness of her foster family, she's beginning to enjoy gentle pets, has discovered the joys of purring, and has even allowed herself to be picked up! Shorty is looking for a calm, patient family who will give her the time and space she needs to continue building her confidence. With a little love, understanding, and plenty of encouragement, this sweet girl has all the potential to blossom into a wonderful companion! I may be able to live with other cats and/or dogs. I may be able to live with children. Please email your completed adoption application to adoption@cochranehumane.ca.

cats.name: Dulce
cats.bio:
Dearest little Dulce is as sweet as her name! Growing more confident daily, she’s actively seeking out pets from her foster mom and purr, purr, purring away. Perpetually playful, she enjoys engaging with her equally sweet siblings, playing with toys and then relaxing by looking out the window. A hearty eater and fully litter box trained, Dulce will delight any calm and patient adoptive home, preferably with one of her purr-ecious sibs.

Dulce was born approximately August 2026. She is currently on-preview and will be available for adoption soon.

cats.name: Toffee
cats.bio: Meet Toffee! Meet Toffee, an adorable 3-month-old kitten with a sweet little face that's sure to melt your heart! At this age, the world is full of exciting things to discover, and Toffee has plenty of growing, playing, and exploring ahead of her. She's looking for a loving family who can provide lots of patience, playtime, and affection as she grows into her personality. If you're looking to add a little sweetness to your life, Toffee might be your perfect match! ❤️ I might be able to live with other cats and/or dogs. I might be able to live with children. Email the filled-out adoption form to: adoption@cochranehumane.ca

cats.name: Apple Crumble
cats.bio: Apple Crumble may have a sweet name, but this little girl is still learning that the world isn't such a scary place! Found as a stray, Apple Crumble is understandably feeling overwhelmed by her new surroundings. Right now, she prefers the safety of her hiding spot and may hiss or growl when she's frightened. It's simply her way of asking for a little space while she figures things out. At just three months old, Apple Crumble has so much growing and learning ahead of her! She'll need a patient, understanding family who can offer her a quiet environment, safe hiding places, and gentle, positive experiences without rushing her.

cats.name: Guacamole
cats.bio:
Give gentle Guacamole time and his sweetness shines through. Still skittish, however, where new people are concerned, he’s following his siblings’ example and learning to trust his foster mom more. Although he’ll accept pets from her, he’s not yet a lap cat, but he does enjoy looking out the window and playing with toys. Highly food motivated and litter box trained, Guacamole will grow into the Guacamole he was meant to be in a patient home, preferably with one of his sweet siblings.

Guacamole was born approximately August 2026. She is currently on-preview and will be available for adoption soon.

cats.name: Nanner
cats.bio: Meet Nanner - the tiny bundle of love and energy that will keep you entertained and on your feet! This little one came in with a group and has had a good time romping around with her siblings, buy is now looking to step out and find her forever home! Kittens need a lot of exercise, mental stimulation, attention and affection and lots of playtime in between their naps! Come see Nanner and find out if she is your new fuzzy family member!
